first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the current completion decline and may also recover activation while improving time-to-value, making it the strongest current fit for sustainable qualified revenue. final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified source shows higher completion, 2.1-day faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention, directly addressing both current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable revenue. Reject promotional pricing despite competitive pressure because its qualified-revenue lift was accompanied by a 12% retention decline and failure through the first renewal cycle. Measure completion, activation, time-to-value, retention, and qualified-revenue indicators before broader rollout.
